veranderings.blok: Rekenaars wat 'n hele kamer gevul het
veranderings.voor: 'n hele kamer gevul van die een muur tot die ander
veranderings.na: 'n hele kamer van die een muur tot die ander gevul
veranderings.rede: In Afrikaans the adverbial phrase naturally comes before the past participle at the end of the clause; the word count stays the same.
'hou ... op' can be misread as the separable verb 'ophou' (stop); 'bewaar' says 'keep' unambiguously, and the word count stays the same.

veranderings.voor: Besighede kan goed koop by en verkoop aan mense in ander lande
veranderings.na: Besighede kan goed by mense in ander lande koop en aan hulle verkoop
veranderings.rede: Stranded prepositions ('koop by en verkoop aan mense') copy the English 'buy from and sell to'; Afrikaans puts each preposition with its own object (one word more).

vlae.teks: Hospitale, banke en winkels werk elke dag hiermee. / Skole en laboratoriums hou hulle inligting op rekenaars.
vlae.rede: The first five items are 'Om ...' purposes that answer the heading, but the last two are full sentences about who uses computers, so the list stops matching its heading; 'hiermee' also has no antecedent inside its own item. Fixing this means rewording the content of the items, so it is flagged, not changed.
